system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Five interactive logon failures for leo.martins occurred on WS-LMARTINS-01 between 13:30:32 and 13:30:56 UTC; each reports an incorrect password (SubStatus 0xc000006a).
WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a successful type 3 network logon for leo.martins at 13:53:41 UTC, from source IP 10.40.10.23. The evidence does not establish who initiated it or why.
Explorer registry activity includes UserAssist entries referencing Microsoft Word and Firefox executable paths under leo.martins's profile.
A Chrome connection to the configured proxy corresponds in time to a successful proxy CONNECT request to www.bing.com:443.

At about 14:07:13 UTC, several processes under leo.martins's session ended within roughly one second, including Zscaler, Cisco AnyConnect, Dropbox, OneDrive, Chrome, cmd.exe, Sublime Text, and Explorer; a type 2 logoff for that session followed at 14:07:16 UTC.
The proxy-related registry setting ProxyEnable was set to 0 at 14:16:57 UTC. This records a setting change, but does not show that traffic bypassed the proxy.
The successful network logon and clustered process exits are unusual enough to warrant investigation, but the available records do not establish malicious intent or activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Coverage metadata reports winsec and Sysmon collection outages on DC-NWD-01 and FILE-NWD-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC; no record IDs were supplied for this metadata.
The supplied records do not include a matching successful interactive logon event for the WS-LMARTINS-01 session that logged off at 14:07:16 UTC.
claims_not_established: Whether the five failed logons were mistyped credentials, deliberate guessing, or caused by another mechanism.
Whether the network logon on WS-NBLAKE-01 was authorized, what activity followed it, or whether source IP 10.40.10.23 identifies a particular person or device.
Why the processes ended close together, and whether the event was user-initiated, administrative, or malicious.
Whether Dropbox or AnyConnect was used for file transfer or remote access; process termination records alone do not establish use.
Whether the proxy setting change led to direct network traffic or otherwise bypassed monitoring.
Whether the authentication and host activity during the DC-NWD-01 and FILE-NWD-01 collection outage was related to these events.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-NWD-01 authentication logs and FILE-NWD-01 winsec/Sysmon logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including authentication outcomes and service or scheduled-job activity.
Identify the device and user associated with source IP 10.40.10.23 at 13:53:41 UTC and validate whether the type 3 logon was expected.
Obtain the corresponding successful interactive logon/session-start event and process creation or termination context for WS-LMARTINS-01 around 14:07 UTC.
Check available proxy, Zeek, and endpoint network evidence around and after the ProxyEnable change to determine whether any traffic bypassed the proxy.
Verify with leo.martins and IT whether the failed logons, network logon, and clustered process exits correspond to expected activity.
